subject: Museum visit timing
text: We can still do the museum visit on Saturday, but we need to settle the meeting time before Friday. One of you prefers 10:00 because of an early shift, while another thinks 11:30 leaves enough time after lunch. I suggest 10:45, since it gives us enough time before the noon crowd. Please reply in the group with one word, either yes or no. The trip is casual, so we are trying to keep it simple. If anyone has a real conflict, say so. Otherwise, I will confirm the reservation and remind everyone to bring student IDs. Admission can be paid separately.
